# Synthetic test media

`synthetic-color.mp4` is a locally generated, one-second FFmpeg `testsrc` color/pattern fixture (320×180, 10 fps, H.264), with no person, voice, garment, or private content. It is used only for deterministic transport/storage tests. It is not a fitting result or a user asset. The source pattern was generated for this test suite; no third-party photography is embedded. FFmpeg binaries are not redistributed.
